{{Quote|I shall perform to the utmost of my operational parameters, Master Quon.|IN-GA 44|<ref name="AotE1" />}}
'''IN-GA 44''', or '''Inga''', was a [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] [[Human replica droid]] created by the [[Sluissi]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Alessi Quon]] for the [[Experi-Tech]] office of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. She was based on a design by famous [[Droid/Legends|droidmaker]] [[Massad Thrumble]] and was not covered in the [[Synthskin/Legends|synthskin]] overlay that was common to most HRDs. The droid was armed with hidden [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] in her [[Limb/Legends|forearms]] and had jets in her calves that enabled her to fly. She worked with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Intelligence [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Jahan Cross]] on field assignments. IN-GA 44 accompanied Cross to the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] for his [[Mission to the Corporate Sector|investigation]] of the [[Iron Eclipse]] project. While there, IN-GA 44 was captured by [[Iaclyn Stark]], the head of [[Rossum Droidworks]], and was infected with the Iron Eclipse [[Computer/Legends|computer]] virus that was designed to give him the ability to command any droid and override all other programming. IN-GA 44 was destroyed when the [[Eclipse station (Reltooine)|Eclipse space station]] fell into the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Reltooine]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I don't know why I bother lending you my best creations, Jahan. You never take care of them, and IN-GA is my masterpiece!|Alessi Quon describes IN-GA 44|<ref name="AotE1" />}}
IN-GA 44, also referred to informally as Inga, was a [[Human replica droid]] (HRD) with [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] programming created by a [[Sluissi]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] named [[Alessi Quon]] for the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] branch of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Quon based her design on [[Droid/Legends|droids]] created by famous droidmaker [[Massad Thrumble]]. IN-GA 44 was a companion and [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to Imperial Intelligence [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Jahan Cross]]. Cross rejected the skin and [[Hair/Legends|hair]] overlays standard for HRDs because he wanted IN-GA 44 to look like a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] rather than a [[Human/Legends|Human]].<ref name="AotE2" />

===Mission on Wayland===
{{Quote|All opponents nonfunctional, Master Jahan.|IN-GA 44, to Cross|<ref name="AotE1" />}}
[[File:IN-GA44-2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|IN-GA 44 deploying her blasters]]
In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], IN-GA 44 was present with Jahan Cross on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] when he was [[Mission to Imperial Research Station 61|investigating]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Milosh Muhrlein]], who was in charge of [[Imperial Research Station 61]], a top-secret [[Research Center|research facility]]. She went through the colonel's records and found confirmation that experimental [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and devices created at the station were the same as those available on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]]. When Muhrlein's attempt to bribe Cross failed, IN-GA 44 switched into battle mode at Cross's command and destroyed Muhrlein's two prototype [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], [[B-2A]] and [[B-2B]].<ref name="AotE1" />

After leaving Wayland, IN-GA 44 accompanied Cross to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During Cross's debriefing with [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]], she was in the [[Experi-Tech]] office, where she was evaluated by her creator, Alessi Quon. After Isard's debriefing, Cross went to get her and in spite of Quon's objection that he still had some evaluations to do on her, he released IN-GA 44 to Jahan for a [[Mission to the Corporate Sector|mission]] to the planet [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]].<ref name="AotE1" />

===Corporate Sector===
{{Quote|Cross to IN-GA 44.''"<br />"''I'm here, Master Cross. I've been monitoring the security comms. You have ''not'' been making friends.|Jahan Cross and IN-GA 44, shortly after Cross escapes Corporate Sector custody|<ref name="AotE2" />}}
Upon arriving at the [[Mondder Spaceport]] on Etti IV in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] with Cross aboard [[Imperial Shuttle 9604]], IN-GA 44 stayed with Jahan's possessions to keep an [[Eye/Legends|eye]] on them and prevent anyone from inspecting them.<ref name="AotE1" /> Later, she accompanied Cross to a party at the [[Imperial Embassy (Etti IV)|Imperial Embassy]], where the droid identified and commented on VIPs for Cross. She gave him information about [[Elli Stark]], the daughter of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Iaco Stark/Legends|Iaco Stark]]; [[Dah'lis Stark]], the second [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of Iaco Stark; [[Emesh Nar]], the aide to the [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] [[Blains Vorlin]], and [[Iaclyn Stark]], the son of Iaco Stark. Cross then sent her back to his room so she could do some research and look for links between Emesh Nar and the [[Stark family]]. IN-GA 44 found out that Nar and Iaclyn Stark were boyhood friends and that the Stark family had used its connections to get Nar his position of aide to Ambassador Vorlin. Later in the evening, the droid was contacted by Cross. While updating Cross on the connection between Nar and the Starks, she was ambushed by Emesh Nar and Iaclyn Stark and was hit with an [[Ion blaster/Legends|ion blast]] that disabled her. The droid was then shipped to the [[Eclipse station (Reltooine)|Eclipse]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]], which was [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the planet [[Reltooine]].<ref name="AotE2" />

===On the Eclipse===
[[File:Inga_says_goodbye.jpg|thumb|right|150px|IN-GA 44's final words]]
{{Quote|Stop. Please. Please stop. You are altering my primary programming.|IN-GA 44, while being reprogrammed with the Iron Eclipse virus|<ref name="AotE4" />}}
While on the Eclipse, IN-GA 44 was [[Programmer/Legends|reprogrammed]] by Iaclyn Stark with the [[Iron Eclipse]] virus. The [[Computer/Legends|computer]] virus allowed the Starks to command any droid and they intended to use it to take over the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Cross and Elli Stark hired a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] known as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] co-pilot [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], to take them to the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] station. After Solo dropped the couple off, they were attacked and attempted to escape from Iaco Stark and his [[Army/Legends|army]] of droids. IN-GA 44 blocked the doorway and was ordered to [[Death/Legends|kill]] them by the elder Stark.<ref name="AotE4" />

IN-GA 44 opened fire on Cross with her [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] but was unable to kill him, consistently pulling her shots wide, as the order to protect him was too deeply wired into her [[Personality matrix/Legends|matrix]]. Cross commanded her to kill Stark, but this order, too, proved impossible due to the Iron Eclipse programming. Cross suggested that by knocking out the [[Repulsorlift generator/Legends|repulsorlift generators]] that held the space station in orbit, she could fulfill both mandates. IN-GA 44 saw the logic in the plan and headed to the lower levels of the space station. Iaco Stark ordered his droids to stop her before she could complete her sabotage. She breached the [[Turbolift/Legends|lift shafts]] and flew down to the repulsorlift generators, which she destroyed with her blasters. The resulting shockwave disabled her weapons and jets, and allowed the other droids chasing her to catch up with her. She destroyed many in vicious [[Unarmed combat/Legends|hand-to-hand combat]]. IN-GA 44 then made her way to an exterior door, where she contacted Cross via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. She explained that she was unable to fly and therefore could not escape the dying station. IN-GA 44 was destroyed along with the rest of Eclipse, as it could no longer resist the pull of Reltooine's [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] and fell into the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the planet.<ref name="AotE5" />

Having been rescued earlier by Solo and Chewbacca, Cross made the decision not to return to the station and believed that he should not jeopardize the ''Millennium Falcon'' by attempting to save his droid. Cross also thought that IN-GA 44 might still be infected by the Iron Eclipse virus and that she might still try to kill him due to the virus's commands. If she was not, she would have the only remaining copies of the virus's code, and Cross did not want that to fall into the Empire's hands, because he thought the virus would cause chaos.<ref name="AotE5" />

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Your droid, Cross. Very unusual. Haven't seen the like of it before. A human replica droid, I believe. A Massad Thrumble design?|Iaclyn Stark, upon first seeing IN-GA 44|<ref name="AotE2" />}}
IN-GA 44 was a bipedal [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]&ndash;shaped droid with a female personality. She was clad in [[Color/Legends|silver]] and purple plating. She had two green [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]] on her smooth face but after being infected with the Iron Eclipse virus, her right photoreceptor turned red.<ref name="AotE4" /> IN-GA 44 did not have any individual toes, although she did have five fingers at the end of each [[Limb/Legends|arm]].<ref name="AotE1" /> She had cone-shaped [[Audio sensor/Legends|audio sensors]] with a vertical attachment, though she lacked the skin and hair overlay normally applied to HRDs due to Jahan Cross's desire for droids to "look like droids."<ref name="AotE2" />

IN-GA 44 was extremely adept in combat and was able to successfully defeat multiple droid opponents at the same time.<ref name="AotE1" /><ref name="AotE5" /> She was armed with hidden blasters in her forearms and had leg jets located in her calves that enabled her to fly. She was a [[Class four droid/Legends|class four droid]] designed for combat operations.<ref name="AotE1" /><ref name="AotE5" />

==Behind the scenes==
IN-GA 44 was created by [[John Ostrander]] for the [[Star Wars: Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse|''Star Wars: Agent of the Empire—Iron Eclipse'']] story arc, published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="AotE1" /> from [[December]] [[2011]]<ref name="AotE1-DH">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/19-034/Star-Wars-Agent-of-the-Empire-1-St-phane-Roux-cover|text=Star Wars: Agent of the Empire #1 (Stéphane Roux cover)}}</ref> to [[April]] [[2012]].<ref name="AotE5-DH">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/19-038/Star-Wars-Agent-of-the-Empire-Iron-Eclipse-5|text=Star Wars: Agent of the Empire&mdash;Iron Eclipse #5}}</ref>
